repairs.defect: concurrent appends could race the canonical head
repairs.repair: per-journal flock serializes validation, append, sync, and reopen verification

repairs.defect: reuse checked only count/head and could accept same-cardinality content tamper or wrong transaction
repairs.repair: validate transaction identity and every canonical idempotency row; rebuild temp-first with fsync and atomic replace

repairs.defect: creation/version initialization and durable reopen identity were split and weak
repairs.repair: exclusive no-follow leaf creation, owner/mode checks, one schema/version/metadata transaction, DB and parent fsync, reopen with WAL/FULL and exact identity/schema/chain verification

repairs.defect: receipt/event transitions did not require all frozen transaction, epoch, contract, authority, request, and prior-receipt bindings
repairs.repair: strict common journal context and event binding checks plus current-row receipt chain-head verification

repairs.defect: safe resume lacked recovered-new-epoch and prerequisite predicates
repairs.repair: require new SUPERVISOR_RECOVERED epoch, forbidden-history absence, and explicit safe-resume predicates

repairs.defect: outcome journal record did not prove CAS-backed response bytes
repairs.repair: CAS capture supports protected extra bindings; authority verifies canonical CAS path, digest, byte count, capture schema, response digest and prior receipt

repairs.defect: existing published objects were not rejected when hardlinked
repairs.repair: require one link for published CAS objects while preserving explicit descriptor-bound source hardlink policy
